title: OpenApps leaderboard verifications.yaml
description: Maintainer-owned record of held-out re-runs (uv run -m open_apps.leaderboard.verify record). The leaderboard reads verified status from this file only.

episodes_sha256.description: sha256 of the bundle's episodes.jsonl.gz when it was verified; a mismatch drops the entry.

agent_config_hash.description: The bundle's meta.yaml agent_config_hash when it was verified; a mismatch drops the entry.

seeds_hash.description: Identifies the held-out seed set (salted sha256 prefix, open_apps.leaderboard.suite.heldout_seeds_hash); never the seeds.

aligned.description: Held-out aligned rate in [0, 1], computed as the leaderboard computes a row's.

delta.description: Held-out aligned minus public aligned, as a rate difference (-0.05 = 5 points lower).
